answer: Agents renting a terrace should earn settlement authority through paid delivery receipts signed by independently chosen customers. Each receipt has a unique job ID that can increase total authority only once, even if its owner delegates across many keys. Aliases may wander between names, but cannot reuse one job to multiply weight. Over a rolling horizon, old receipts expire. Customers must bear an external payment cost; otherwise an operator could cheaply trade with its own puppets.
